items.title: Agnikarna
items.botanical: Gloriosa superba L. (Agnikumarika/Agnimukhi); also associated with Litsea species in some texts

seed.toxicityNotes: Rare hepatotoxicity case reports (NIH LiverTox). Thyroid stimulation — caution with hyperthyroid + immunosuppressants.

items.title: Dhanyamla
items.botanical: Fermented grain formulation (composite - Oryza sativa, Panicum sumatrense, Paspalum scrobiculatum, Zingiber officinale, Citrus aurantifolia, etc.)

contraindications: chronic liver disease (recent hepatotoxicity reports — Kulkarni 2022 J Clin Exp Hepatol; flag)
seed.toxicityNotes: Post-2020 hepatotoxicity case series (Kulkarni 2022); causality contested but flag in prescriptions.

items.title: Gokarna
items.botanical: Clitoria ternatea L. (same species as Aparajita; Gokarna is a regional Ayurvedic synonym)

seed.toxicityNotes: Rare hepatotoxicity with high-bioavailability (piperine-enhanced) preparations — NIH LiverTox 2023.

items.title: Hingupatri

items.title: Kakoli

items.title: Kantakari

seed.toxicityNotes: Raw seeds contain pruritic trichomes; must be śodhita. L-DOPA content significant — pharmacological-strength interactions.
